notes.why_in_news: The UN's World Urbanisation Prospects 2025 report identifies Jakarta as the world's most populous city due to revised geospatial methodology.
notes.fact_box: Jakarta now holds the top spot with 42 million people, followed by Dhaka (37 million) and Tokyo (33 million). The report notes that urban dwellers now comprise nearly half of the world's 8.2 billion people.
